description: test_killswitch.test_inputs_are_both_in_jpy_units (line 66-74) is tautological: it only inspects the function's parameter NAMES via inspect.signature and asserts 'cum_cost_jpy' / 'cum_earned_jpy' substrings appear. This is a documentation check, not a dimensional correctness check. PROP-B4-killswitch spec says 'dimensional check via type annotations + a fuzz test asserting type-coherence' — there is no fuzz test, no annotation-based type check. A future renaming or accidental swap of the args at a call site would not be caught. This is the manifest's AI-slop signal (ii): test that uses a 'magic' constant the implementation just happens to honor (here, the param name).

evidence.snippet: def test_inputs_are_both_in_jpy_units(): sig = inspect.signature(kill_switch_tripped); assert 'cum_cost_jpy' in sig.parameters; assert 'cum_earned_jpy' in sig.parameters
